# Stack Diagram Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Draws clean architecture diagrams of a tech stack, with real brand logos, grouped containers and orthogonal arrows, as HTML or PNG. It fetches official logos, plans the layout, builds one self-contained HTML file, renders a PNG to check it by eye, then delivers the format asked for.

The skill settles nodes, groups and edges first, fetches official logos, plans coordinates, builds from the template, then renders a PNG to look at before delivery. It covers AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and Kubernetes icon rules, plus Lucide pictograms for abstract concepts, and delivers HTML, PNG, a React component or a live artifact. Companion scripts and the template are described here only as the SKILL.md presents them, so examine them in the repo before use.
